response.overview: Kim Johnson, a 50-year-old Army major, and her 13-year-old autistic, nonbinary child, Ace, are on a high-stakes journey to a prestigious music audition in Washington, D.C. What begins with a nervous pickup from school spirals into a frantic search through the music academy when mix-ups leave them scrambling to find the right audition room.
response.title: The Audition
